title: The Dark Truth About The Marvelous Land of Oz #Shorts
description:
Nothing in The Marvelous Land of Oz was built for you — it was built for reproduction. The Marvelous Land of Oz: Being an Account of the Further Adventures of the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman, commonly shortened to The Land of Oz, published in July 1904, is the second book in L. Frank Baum's Oz series, and the sequel to The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (1900).

What culture calls destiny in The Marvelous Land of Oz is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. The protagonist, like Tip/Ozma, is a lost princess sent away from The O.Z. and magically altered to forget much of her previous existence. This was the third in a series of four audiotapes, The Oz Audio Collection, recorded by Bolger and issued by Caedmon Audio from 1976-1983.
